title: reject scenario's selection pin is dead code — `&&` over mutually-exclusive selection fields can never fire
evidence:
case "input_parity_reject":
		if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Mouse); ok && r.sel_node != -1 && r.sel_pipe != -1 {
			append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s mouse: a rejected draw must not change the selection (sel pipe %d, node %d)",
 — and the selection setters are mutually exclusive (app/input/exec.odin:393-394 `inp.sel_node = i64(id)` / `inp.sel_pipe = -1`; :405-406 `inp.sel_pipe = i64(pid)` / `inp.sel_node = -1`; :553-554 `inp.sel_pipe = i64(pid)` / `inp.sel_node = -1`)
detail: The scenario comment promises "a rejected draw must not change the selection", but the assert requires BOTH sel_node and sel_pipe non -1. Every selection path sets one and clears the other, and this fixture contains no selectable pipe — the clause is unreachable, so a selection-mutating rejection regression ships green.
recommended_fix: Change the `&&` to `||` (fail if either sel_node or sel_pipe changed from -1), so the pin matches its comment.

title: pad_cursor pin never observes its promised first-Up boundary — a no-op Dpad_Up mapping passes the assert
detail: Only the final cursor (pad_node == 0) is asserted; the promised intermediate "first Dpad_Up lands on the LAST alive node (2)" is never observed. A regression making Dpad_Up a no-op leaves pad_has false, and first-placement Dpad_Down then lands on node 0 — the scenario passes with the pinned boundary broken.
recommended_fix: Assert the intermediate state: stop a variant scenario after the Dpad_Up frame and require pad_has && pad_node == 2, then keep the wrap assert.

title: .memlog.md committed to the repo for the first time, and its "(11 scenarios)" is stale against the shipped 17
evidence: - JOB 5.4 done-design: app/input intent layer (Device_Event -> Intent -> ONE executor), mouse transcription + touch/pad mappings, harness input-parity (11 scenarios), goldens input_parity_draw{,wide}.t1, CI gate. — vs the shipped matrix ending at harness/parity.odin:618 `// 17. pad_cursor — W10 pin: the pad_step boundaries — first Dpad_Up lands` (`harness input-parity` at d91109e prints "PASS input-parity   17 scenario(s) green")
detail: The briefing's scope guard is "input parity ONLY"; .memlog.md is a minion process log absent at the base sha and committed here for the first time, and its "(11 scenarios)" count predates the six r1-fix scenarios (17 ship). Repo hygiene + stale committed docs, not a correctness defect.
recommended_fix: Drop .memlog.md from the PR, or refresh the entry to 17 scenarios in the fix commit so the committed log matches the shipped harness.
